class.name: GodotDoctorCLIRunner
class.brief_description: A [GodotDoctorRunner] for headless / CLI mode. Iterates over all [GodotDoctorValidationSuite] instances defined in [member GodotDoctorSettings.validation_suites] and validates their scenes and resources.

method.name: _run_for_suites
method.description: Iterates over all configured validation suites and runs each one.

method.name: _run_for_suite
method.description: Runs validation for all scenes and resources listed in [param validation_suite].

method.name: _run_for_scenes_in_suite
method.description: Runs validation for all scenes listed in [param validation_suite].

method.name: _run_for_scene_path
method.description: Runs validation for the scene at [param res_or_uid_scene_path].

method.name: _run_for_resources_in_suite
method.description: Runs validation for all resources listed in [param validation_suite].

method.name: _run_for_resource_path
method.description: Runs validation for the resource at [param resource_res_or_uid_path].

signal.name: started_validation_suite_collection
signal.description: Emitted when starting collection of results across all validation suites.

signal.name: finished_validation_suite_collection
signal.description: Emitted when finishing collection of results across all validation suites.

signal.name: started_run_for_validation_suite
signal.description: Emitted when starting validation for [param suite].

signal.name: finished_run_for_validation_suite
signal.description: Emitted when finishing validation for [param suite].
